claim: Nine real AppSumo orders
evidence: 9 payable-code sales; QA licence excluded from customer cohort
implication: AppSumo is the only proven purchase channel

claim: Gross AppSumo GMV is $801
implication: Only $199 gross remains to a $1,000 gross target

claim: Partner revenue is $183.97
implication: $816.03 remains to $1,000 founder proceeds

claim: AppSumo discounts total $88.58
implication: Sticker price and buyer-paid net revenue must not be mixed

claim: No AppSumo refunds are recorded
implication: Current portal revenue is unreduced by recorded refunds but remains subject to settlement timing

claim: Direct Stripe retained revenue is zero
implication: One GBP 7 charge was fully refunded; no active subscription

claim: Seven of nine real AppSumo orders redeemed
implication: Two buyers have not reached product value; one is less than a day old

claim: Completed Ask is the most common observed buyer action
implication: Promote and improve Ask activation; do not claim it caused purchase

claim: Ask usage is concentrated
implication: Average Ask usage overstates typical adoption

claim: Four of seven buyers have attributable page telemetry
implication: Page matrices are lower bounds; missing is NA rather than zero

claim: One buyer has an observable pre-purchase product journey
implication: The purchase aha moment is not identifiable for six buyers

claim: The only observed pre-purchase sequence repeatedly visited dossier
implication: Dossier is a hypothesis for conversion, not validated causal evidence

claim: Tier 2/3 buyers all used Ask
implication: Tier 3 should lead the AppSumo conversion narrative, subject to tiny-n caveat

claim: Six of seven buyers used Ask
implication: Source-backed Ask is the strongest observed activation signal

claim: Buyer discovery is unknown for eight orders
implication: Do not credit X, search, direct, or AppSumo internal discovery without evidence

claim: One buyer explicitly discovered the AppSumo lifetime deal
source: Customer presale email plus order timing
evidence: buyer asked to purchase Tier 3 after seeing AppSumo
implication: AppSumo offer and trust can close high-intent prospects

claim: Google organic clicks are concentrated in comparisons
implication: Protect comparison pages; no revenue attribution is proven

claim: Recent Google search volume is very small
implication: SEO is not the shortest path to immediate revenue

claim: WAB query impressions show no clicks
implication: Do not mistake rank-check patterns for commercial demand

claim: Bing produced 38 clicks
implication: Bing contributes real traffic but purchase attribution remains unknown

claim: X produced no verified customers
source: X Content export plus first-party events
evidence: 37 native link clicks; first-party X events show zero signups/activations/purchases
implication: Use X for evidence-led testing, not as a proven revenue channel

claim: A detailed NVDA original outperformed tracked replies on link clicks
evidence: NVDA post 7 clicks; 37 tracked replies 2 clicks
implication: Prefer one strong sourced research post over reply volume

claim: Public review validates efficiency but raises accuracy verification
evidence: 1 review; 5 tacos; reviewer still cross-verifying accuracy
implication: Lead with evidence inspection and avoid absolute accuracy claims

claim: Buyer requests include ETF coverage and API/MCP/alerts
evidence: four distinct Q&A themes; each low frequency
implication: Use as discovery evidence; not enough to justify building API/MCP

claim: Current Clarity recent traffic includes more bots than humans
implication: Raw traffic spikes must be filtered before interpreting growth

claim: Recent external Clarity sessions were shallow
evidence: 3 search sessions produced 1 click and no cross-page navigation; the X session produced 1 click and stayed on the homepage
implication: Improve landing-to-next-step discovery; do not infer population rates from the purposive sample

claim: Nominal Clarity duration overstates active engagement
evidence: at least 6 of 10 sampled sessions were hidden or backgrounded early
implication: Use verified actions, active time and page depth rather than raw duration

claim: Sampled clicks were concentrated in two screener sessions
evidence: 2 screener sessions generated 85 of 95 sampled click events; one contained a dead click and one looked potentially QA-like
implication: Do not interpret aggregate click counts as broad engagement; reproduce the dead-click control separately

claim: GA4 current API analysis is blocked
implication: GA4 cannot currently validate channel conversions

claim: AppSumo partner link advertises 90% revenue for new AppSumo customers
evidence: portal states 90% of total revenue from every new customer brought through unique URL
implication: New-to-AppSumo prospects could materially improve unit economics; eligibility must be verified per buyer
